question: A Claude.ai Pro user wants their conversations excluded from any model training data, but they've enabled the optional "model improvement" setting and use Incognito chats occasionally. What happens to their Incognito chats?
options: A) Incognito chats follow the 5-year retention rule instead of the standard 30-day deletion window
B) Incognito chats are excluded from model training even when the model improvement setting is enabled
C) Incognito chats are automatically flagged for trust and safety review regardless of content
D) Incognito chats are included in model training whenever the model improvement setting is turned on
correct_answers: B) Incognito chats are excluded from model training even when the model improvement setting is enabled
explanations: Incorrect. The 5-year rule applies to conversations retained under the model improvement setting, which does not apply to Incognito chats since they're excluded from training.
Correct. Incognito chats are specifically excluded from model training, even for users who have otherwise opted into the model improvement setting for their other conversations.
Incorrect. Trust and safety flagging depends on detected policy violations in content, not on whether a chat was conducted in Incognito mode.
Incorrect. The model improvement setting applies to a user's regular conversations; Incognito chats carry their own exclusion regardless of that setting.
